prose:
Epoch AI estimates growth in Anthropic and OpenAI compute spending using disclosures and media reports, converting mixed reporting periods into annualized rates. The analysis distinguishes the richer Anthropic filing data from sparse OpenAI observations and forecasts.

Run rates are not actual full-year totals, and the fitted historical growth rates are not commitments about future growth. The report explains interpolation, regression and accounting limits, including the difference between internal research and customer-serving compute.
highlights: Sources differ in completeness across companies
Quarterly spending is annualized for comparison
Fit assumes growth between reporting periods
Forecasted and observed amounts are distinct
Historical multipliers do not guarantee future growth
Compute spend includes more than customer inference
